# §26 — Revision disposition and release boundary
**CHD-3.4 · SPEC V3.4. REVISION NOTICE — supersedes CHD-3.3.**
The edition completes authoring corrections without claiming full product buildability. Integration OPEN statuses are preserved, with authoring progress separately classified. No runtime service or PDF is validated by this source handoff.

## 26.2 Required release evidence
Native allocation/unknown lookup, correlated stop attestation, native archive payload/import and atomic storage fence/snapshot binding remain unresolved. Full MCP publication remains blocked on IF-06/IF-07. QA must execute the specified falsifying cases against version-bound implementations before promoting runtime status. Rendering, final folios, black-and-white/font/fit checks, visual QA and print-safe production belong to the downstream render/QA cards.

## 26.3 Baseline and supersession
The available physical source baseline is handbook/chd32 with CHD-3.3 correction paragraphs. No separately rendered CHD-3.3 set was found in that source tree. CHD-3.4 nevertheless supersedes CHD-3.3 as directed; it does not invent a prior PDF or folio mapping. Historical HTML/PDF and source snapshots remain untouched. Old-to-new semantic mapping retains sections 1–16 and adds 17–26; physical page mapping is generated after rendering.
